name: Klaipėda
title: Klaipėda Thickness Gauging: Ship UTM & Hull Inspection
description: Thickness measurement in Klaipėda for ships docking at Western Shipyard or calling at the LNG and oil terminals: renewal survey, ESP and pre-docking UTM.
h1: Ship Thickness Measurement and Hull Inspection in Klaipėda
intro: Klaipėda is Lithuania's seaport and the northernmost ice-free port on the eastern Baltic coast. It combines a large ship-repair yard with container and ro-pax traffic, an oil terminal and the floating LNG terminal Independence. Ships come here to dock as well as to trade. For docking, ESP and pre-purchase work we bring a team from India to Klaipėda, planned around the yard slot or the ship's port stay.

highlights.p: Western Shipyard, part of BLRT Grupp, repairs merchant ships in its floating docks on the Klaipėda Strait. Renewal-survey and pre-docking gauging there gives the yard and surveyor a measured steel list at the start of the stay.

Klaipėda normally stays open all winter, so ships can be docked and gauged in the colder months when ice restricts ports further north. External hull work still has to allow for cold and short daylight.

The floating LNG terminal Independence and the KN oil terminal bring LNG carriers and tankers to Klaipėda. Deck, ballast and piping gauging on those ships is fitted around cargo operations and terminal safety rules.

port.h: Klaipėda State Seaport and its traffic
p: Klaipėda State Seaport lines the Klaipėda Strait, the narrow channel that links the Curonian Lagoon with the open Baltic, with terminals strung along the mainland side opposite the Curonian Spit. It handles containers through several terminals, ro-pax services run by DFDS to Kiel and Karlshamn, dry bulk including grain and fertilisers, general and project cargo, and liquid bulk through the KN oil terminal. The floating storage and regasification unit Independence, moored in the port area, has made Klaipėda an LNG import point for the region, and a crude terminal at Būtingė on the coast to the north supplies the refinery at Mažeikiai.

That spread of trades brings a varied fleet: container feeders, ro-pax and ro-ro ships, bulk carriers, general cargo and multipurpose ships, product tankers and LNG carriers. On top of that comes the repair traffic. Western Shipyard, part of BLRT Grupp, docks and repairs merchant ships in its floating docks, and ships arrive in Klaipėda for no other reason than to dock. For them, the port stay is the docking itself, and the gauging programme decides how much steel the yard will renew and how long the ship stays.

Ships stay long enough to gauge in several ways. Dockings give fixed periods with full access to the shell. Bulk and general cargo ships load and discharge over a day or more. Ro-pax on the German and Swedish routes have lay-by periods and planned dockings, and ships wait at anchor outside the port for berths or dock slots. What makes Klaipėda distinctive is that it is both a trading port and a repair destination, and that it stays open in winter. Owners whose ships trade to ice-bound northern ports can bring them south to dock while those ports are restricted. Klaipėda ship repair is therefore as much a winter business as a summer one, and gauging planned before arrival lets the dock time be used well.

facilities.h: Gauging locations in and around Klaipėda
p: In the floating docks at Western Shipyard, gauging starts as soon as the ship is out of the water and the first areas are cleaned and staged. Access equipment, cleaning and gas-freeing come from the yard; the order in which we measure follows where the surveyor expects renewal, so those compartments are reported first. Ships that arrive with a pre-docking gauging report done at an earlier call need less time for this, because the surveyor can verify rather than wait.

Along the cargo terminals, gauging follows the ship's cargo plan. Container feeders and ro-pax have scheduled calls, so their scopes are prepared in advance and split across visits. Bulk carriers are measured hold by hold, and tankers at the KN oil terminal on deck and piping under the permit system, with the cargo tanks deferred until gas-free. Permanently moored units such as the LNG terminal present a different problem: there is no dry-docking to wait for, so hull and piping gauging has to be fitted into continuous operation. Ships at anchor are reached by launch through the agent, usually for pre-docking readings before they enter the yard.
list: Western Shipyard (BLRT Grupp) — floating docks on the strait; ESP and other renewal-survey gauging with daily read-outs to the yard and class
Container and general cargo terminals along the Klaipėda Strait — feeder and multipurpose ships; hatch covers, coamings, decks and ballast tanks measured in the hours of each call
Ro-pax terminal — DFDS ferries to Kiel and Karlshamn; staged gauging of vehicle decks, ramps and voids during turnarounds and lay-by
KN oil terminal — product tankers alongside; deck and pipeline gauging cleared through the terminal and the ship before it starts
LNG terminal area — the moored FSRU and visiting LNG carriers; ballast tanks, deck and sea water lines gauged while the unit keeps operating
Klaipėda anchorage — ships lying outside the port until the yard or a terminal can take them; reached by a launch the agent organises

p: Lithuania applies Paris MoU port state control. On emissions, Klaipėda sits under two Baltic regimes: the SOx ECA's 0.10% fuel sulphur cap, and NOx Tier III requirements for ships built from 2021. Scrubbers are common on the feeders and ro-ro tonnage calling here, which makes their discharge lines and shell connections a routine item to measure during calls or dockings. Emissions on voyages to and from Klaipėda have been subject to the EU ETS since 2024, and the ships' energy use to FuelEU Maritime since 2025, and both make the steel renewal decision at a docking a sharper commercial question for owners of older ships.

Energy security has shaped the port. The LNG terminal and the Būtingė crude terminal gave Lithuania import routes independent of pipelines from the east, and they bring LNG carriers and crude and product tankers whose owners face vetting and, for older tankers, CAP requests. Bulk carriers docking at Western Shipyard are ESP ships, single-skin designs under IACS UR Z10.2 and double-skin under Z10.5, and their renewal-survey gauging grows at each five-year cycle. ESP gauging in Lithuania is therefore concentrated in the docks, while deck and piping work on tankers is done at the terminals.

jobs.h: Typical thickness gauging jobs in Klaipėda
jobs.p: Klaipėda jobs fall into two groups: work in dock at Western Shipyard, where the gauging decides the renewal list, and work alongside the terminals, where it is fitted around cargo. The two often connect, with pre-docking gauging at one call feeding a docking at the next. Ro-pax gauging on the German and Swedish routes runs on the ferry timetable and is split into visit-sized packages.
list: Day-one readings for a bulk carrier's renewal survey in a Western Shipyard floating dock, covering bottom, side shell and cargo hold structure under the ESP rules
Ballast-tank and deck readings on a container feeder at a Klaipėda terminal, taken ahead of docking and sent to the yard before she returns
Staged vehicle-deck, ramp and void gauging on a Kiel-route ro-pax during lay-by, with magnetic particle checks at the ramp hinge lugs
Wall-thickness readings on the cargo, ballast and stripping lines and the main deck of a product tanker at the KN oil terminal, ahead of her intermediate survey
Sea water, fire main and ballast piping gauging on a permanently moored unit, planned around its operating schedule rather than a dry-docking

logistics: Palanga International Airport is the closest to Klaipėda, while Vilnius and Riga offer wider international connections followed by a road transfer. Port and terminal gate passes are arranged through the ship's agent, shipyard entry through Western Shipyard, and ships at anchor are reached by launch. Lithuania is in Schengen, so our team from India needs a Schengen visa before departure, and we fix dates with the docking slot early to keep the consular timeline comfortable. Winter dockings need the same lead time as summer ones.
vessels: LNG carriers and floating LNG units

faqs.q: Can you gauge our ship during its docking at Western Shipyard?
faqs.a: We can, provided the owner places the order with us and Western Shipyard admits the team. Staging, cleaning and gas-freeing are the yard's part of the docking; ours is to measure each area the moment it is released and pass the figures to the superintendent and the class surveyor at the end of every shift. Steel can then be ordered while the floating dock programme is still flexible, which keeps the stay from stretching.

faqs.q: Why bring a ship to Klaipėda to dock in winter?
faqs.a: Klaipėda keeps working through a normal winter while ports further north are under winter traffic restrictions, and reaching the yard does not depend on icebreaker escort. For gauging, a winter docking works the same as a summer one inside the ship; outdoor shell work in the dock needs low-temperature couplant and planning around short daylight.

faqs.q: Can you gauge a permanently moored unit like the FSRU?
faqs.a: We can gauge hull structure, ballast spaces, deck structure and sea water, fire main and ballast piping on permanently moored units, within the operator's permit system. There is no dry-docking to wait for, so the work is planned around continuous operation and agreed with the operator and class. LNG cargo containment systems are a specialist field and are not part of our scope.

faqs.q: How early should we book gauging before a Klaipėda docking?
faqs.a: The moment the yard confirms the slot. The team needs a Schengen visa, and pre-docking gauging is most useful when it is done at a port call well before the docking, so the yard can order steel in advance. If that is not possible, we plan to arrive as the ship enters dock and concentrate on the areas most likely to need renewal first.
